column1: # Farming patch states: the raw varbit value ranges for every supported patch type, as Spyglass decodes them.
# (RuneLite master @ e98399f931c6, BSD 2-Clause; Copyright (c) 2019 Abex), with Spyglass's refinements
# (CHECK_HEALTH, STANDING / STUMP, GROWN). See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md ("Farming patch tables and capture guards").
# Rows are tried in order; the first whose range holds the value decides it. Values in no row decode as UNKNOWN.
# stage: OFFSET n = value - n; REVERSE n = n - value; CONST n = n; LAST = the produce's last growth stage.
# Columns: type, lo, hi, condition, produce (- for none), stage mode, stage parameter, sub-state
